method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-15T01:03Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Thursday of Week 6 during SEA@DEN TNF, stamped vibe week reg-6. Volume landed for all 32 clubs. Loudest rooms by volume: SEA, DEN, HOU, PHI, BUF, CHI, NE, DAL, ARI, CLE. SEA and DEN volume driven by tonight's TNF game; HOU (~3.7k) still inflated by #WeAreTexans/Texas noise; NE and NYJ counts include non-NFL #Patriots/#Jets bleed. IND, MIA, MIN, NE quiet after filter (pools were CFB, NBA, NHL, F1, NASCAR, MLS, fashion, or other clubs). Dropped mostly college football (Notre Dame-BYU, Arch Manning/Red River, CFP 24-team expansion, Ohio State-Indiana, Miami-FSU, Kentucky-Oklahoma, Vols), MLB NLCS/ALCS, NBA preseason/Knicks, NHL, F1/IndyCar/NASCAR, Steve Madden fashion, Filipino celebrity trend, Kordell Stewart HBO doc and Reggie White clip nostalgia, Julio-vs-London radio poll, Commanders gold-pants uniform post, Sherman pregame gag, Spirit Day graphics, Keion White Feb shooting arrests, and heavy cross-club near-dupes (TNF preview, Allen MVP, Giants-NFC East).

items.title: Jeremiyah Love misses practice again (ankle)
items.one_line: Rookie back sat out again with an ankle issue; LaFleur says Love is used mostly as a pass-blocker given the shaky line.

items.title: Fans crowdfund #BidwillOut billboards
items.one_line: A GoFundMe matched to about $8k put SELL THE TEAM billboards on Phoenix freeways after the 1-4 start.

items.title: Carson Beck stays emergency third QB
items.one_line: Cardinals stick with Brissett as starter and Minshew as backup, keeping the rookie inactive despite fan calls to evaluate him.

items.title: Penix set to start vs. Bears
items.one_line: Full Wednesday practice after the rib injury and a positive MRI; Stefanski says Penix starts Sunday barring setbacks.

items.title: C.J. Henderson questionable (groin)
items.one_line: Ulbrich talked up CB depth with Henderson questionable; fans skeptical given Mike Hughes' 37.5 PFF coverage grade.

items.title: Lamar DNP again, Sunday in doubt
items.one_line: Jackson was a non-participant Thursday with the left ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley would start again vs. Cleveland if he can't go.

items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane's 21-day window opens
items.one_line: Rookie WR back at full practice after a wrist injury; a league source called Lamar's Sunday return realistic earlier in the week.

items.title: Crosby pass vs. Hendrickson debate
items.one_line: Fans defend backing out of the Maxx Crosby trade over his knee, which freed the No. 14 pick for OL Vega Ioane, now steadying the line.

items.title: DJ Moore misses 2nd straight practice (shoulder)
items.one_line: Sprained AC joint, first hurt Week 2 and re-aggravated Week 4; Bills play Las Vegas Sunday before the bye.

items.title: Allen's 121 rush yards beat Rams in OT
items.one_line: 37-34 OT win to 4-1, with a blocked Rams FG, a James Cook OT fumble, and Tyler Bass's 45-yard winner.

items.title: Allen leads MVP odds, schedule debate
items.one_line: Allen favored in early MVP markets while fans argue over the Bills' soft .360 strength of schedule.

items.title: Hurts out vs. Panthers (blood clot)
items.one_line: Eagles ruled Jalen Hurts out of Sunday's game at Carolina after a follow-up ultrasound showed movement in a calf blood clot.

items.title: Caleb Williams full practice, eyes return
items.one_line: Williams called it a significant hamstring tear; he must clear final medical checks to start Sunday vs. Atlanta.

items.title: Burrow tops catchable-throw chart
items.one_line: An analytics chart through Week 5 put Joe Burrow at the top in catchable throw rate, fueling a QB debate.

items.title: Shedeur Sanders signs agent amid trade buzz
items.one_line: Watson's backup signed with Young Money APAA Sports; some read the timing as a hint at trade talks.

items.title: Pettine hired to help DC Parker
items.one_line: Mike Pettine joins as Christian Parker's right-hand man; Dak noticed a different defensive approach after a players-only meeting.

items.title: Joey Porter Jr. eyes full workload at GB
items.one_line: The traded CB was limited Wednesday after a stomach illness kept him out of the last game, but expects a full load Sunday night.

items.title: DaRon Bland vows a pick-six
items.one_line: Bland, allowing 74.2% completions with a 45.0 coverage grade, promised a game-changing INT at Lambeau.

items.title: Moss active; Surtain, Hufanga out for TNF
items.one_line: Riley Moss returns from the rib injury, but Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) sit tonight vs. Seattle.

items.title: Bo Nix under growing scrutiny
items.one_line: 59.9% completions and an 80.8 rating through five games; Cowherd-style Trubisky comps are flying.

items.title: Bolles leads tackles in sack-free snaps
items.one_line: PFF has Garett Bolles at 1,077 straight sack-free snaps, first among active tackles.

items.title: DeAndre Carter to practice squad
items.one_line: Lions signed the veteran returner after Kennedy's Week 5 injury needed season-ending surgery.

items.title: Parsons stays on PUP, out vs. Dallas
items.one_line: Micah Parsons said on his podcast he's 9.5 months post-ACL and will miss Sunday night's game.

items.title: Josh Jacobs sues to block video release
items.one_line: Jacobs filed suit seeking to keep police records and garage footage from a May 23 incident sealed.

items.title: Watson and Golden lead NFL WR duos
items.one_line: Watson (474 yds, 6 TD) and Golden (397 yds) are the league's top receiving pair after Watson's 143-yard day vs. Chicago.

items.title: Dell, Montgomery, Pitre out for London
items.one_line: Tank Dell (knee), David Montgomery (groin), and Jalen Pitre (shoulder) are ruled out vs. Jacksonville at Wembley.

items.title: Will Anderson Jr. leads DPOY race
items.one_line: Kalshi has Anderson at 45% for DPOY; he leads the league in sacks and tackles for loss.

items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. trade talk
items.one_line: Nine catches for 105 yards and snaps down to 48% have fans floating BTJ trade packages.

items.title: Rice out all week, Simmons back limited
items.one_line: Rashee Rice (hamstring) won't practice this week; LT Josh Simmons returned limited from a back issue.

items.title: Chiefs 8.5-point favorites over 0-5 Chargers
items.one_line: Expert picks lean lopsided toward Kansas City at Arrowhead on Sunday.

items.title: Jeanty is playing vs. Bills
items.one_line: Kubiak confirmed Ashton Jeanty plays Sunday after a full Wednesday practice; the ankle is off the report.

items.title: Khalil Mack trade to 49ers nearing
items.one_line: Reports say the Chargers are finalizing a deal sending Mack to San Francisco for a mid-to-late-round pick.

items.title: McDaniel interim-replacement risk
items.one_line: Rapoport says Adam Gase could take over the offense on an interim basis if it doesn't improve at 0-5.

items.title: Alec Ingold to IR (shoulder)
items.one_line: Fullback out at least four games, with a possible Week 11 return.

items.title: Alaric Jackson suspension cut to one game
items.one_line: The LT misses only Week 6 vs. Arizona after appeal and returns Oct. 25 vs. the Raiders.

items.title: Gayle Benson calls 1-4 unacceptable
items.one_line: The owner spread blame across Moore, Loomis, and the players after three straight home losses.

items.title: Paris game vs. Steelers confirmed
items.one_line: The NFL says the Oct. 25 Stade de France game is on despite ongoing student protests.

items.title: Giants injury pile-up before Saints
items.one_line: Andrew Thomas, Jermaine Eluemunor, Abdul Carter, Colton Hood, and Tyler Nubin sat out; Harbaugh expects Thomas to play.

items.title: Giants slight home dogs to 1-4 Saints
items.one_line: The 3-1-1 Giants lean into the underdog role at MetLife.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy package expanding
items.one_line: Harbaugh says Sunday's change-of-pace debut was just a preview behind starter Jameis Winston.

items.title: David Bailey AFC Defensive Player of the Week
items.one_line: The Jets edge had three sacks and seven tackles in Week 5.

items.title: Hurts out vs. Panthers (blood clot)
items.one_line: A follow-up ultrasound showed movement in the small calf clot, so Jalen Hurts sits Sunday at Carolina.

items.title: 24 on injury report; Barkley, Smith DNP
items.one_line: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith missed practice with hamstrings; Landon Dickerson's 21-day window opened.

items.title: Eagles-Commanders SNF flex talk
items.one_line: A loss at Carolina would likely get the Nov. 1 Eagles-Commanders game flexed out of prime time.

items.title: JuJu reunion visit amid WR injuries
items.one_line: Steelers bring in JuJu Smith-Schuster with Michael Pittman Jr., Roman Wilson, and Ben Skowronek hurt before Tampa.

items.title: Rico Dowdle back at full practice
items.one_line: First full practice since the Week 2 toe dislocation, lining him up to return at Tampa; Warren keeps rolling.

items.title: Paris game vs. Saints confirmed
items.one_line: Oct. 25 at Stade de France stays on despite protests in Paris.

items.title: TNF at injury-hit Denver
items.one_line: Seattle went in favored with JSN, the league's receiving yards leader, facing a Broncos secondary missing Surtain.

items.title: Roster flip: Velus Jones back, Charles to PS
items.one_line: Seattle undid Tuesday's moves after the vested-veteran waiver deadline, ahead of TNF.

items.title: 'Aura' debate after 49ers loss
items.one_line: Panelists questioned the defending champs after the 32-29 loss; fans fought it out online.

items.title: Khalil Mack trade nearing
items.one_line: Reports say SF is finalizing a deal for Mack to fill a pass-rush hole.

items.title: Kirk's practice window opens amid WR injuries
items.one_line: Per the X summary, the WR room is missing Mike Evans (Achilles and rib) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring); Nick Bosa (calf) is also out.

items.title: Purdy leads early MVP odds
items.one_line: Purdy is at +300 with a 119.3 passer rating for the 5-0 Niners.

items.title: Mayfield out a third straight game
items.one_line: Thumb dislocation keeps Baker out vs. Pittsburgh; rookie Daniels makes his third straight start.

items.title: Fans grade leadership; CEO responds
items.one_line: A fan survey put CEO Chad Nihill at 2.4 of 10, and Nihill responded.

items.title: 0-5, Saleh backs Cam Ward
items.one_line: Titans have scored a league-low 58 points; Saleh says Ward is the starter despite the criticism.

items.title: Jeffery Simmons trade talk
items.one_line: The winless start has mock trades floating two-first hauls for Simmons despite his extension.

items.title: Amos, Cross, McNichols, Magee full practice
items.one_line: Key defensive returns ahead of Monday night at San Francisco.
